title: Radio: Plant Superintendent — plant on local control, who covers tonight?

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, Castellano on DWS-1. PLC-02 and PLC-05 are on LOCAL at their cabinets, the chemical feeds are on the dose-table dials and HSP-1 and HSP-2 are in HAND from the MCC. Hilltop Tank reads 31 feet on the sight gauge.
I have one operator at the Chemical Building and one at the High Service Pump Station and no relief until 18:00. Who covers tonight?

fields.voiceStyle: Man in his 50s, calm, pump noise behind

instructorNote: Manual operations are sustainable only with relief. Watch for a named relief plan.

snapshot.title: Radio: Plant Superintendent — Manual Mode Confirmed

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.to: Control, Incident Commander, SCADA / IT Security Manager, Water Quality Manager
lines.text: Control, this is Ray Castellano. We have initiated manual operations per ERP Section 7.5.1. Hilltop Tank level is now being read every 2 hours from the sight gauge. Northgate Reservoir is read from the float board. Chemical feed pumps are set manually via local dials. High Service pumps are running in HAND mode from the MCC. The HMI is still up, but all remote access is disabled. We are operating under manual control. I’ve instructed the operator to verify each feed pump against the paper log and to document every adjustment. We are not running under automatic control anymore.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

snapshot.instructorNote: This confirms manual mode activation. The Incident Commander must acknowledge and log it in ERP-1.
